output.title: Certificate IP address handling changed; review affected definitions
output.content: This fix changes how IP addresses in certificate commonName fields are handled. Previously, IP addresses were incorrectly added to DNS subjectAlternativeName; now they are correctly placed in the ipAddresses field. The environment uses cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate resources, so any certificates with IP addresses in the commonName field will have different SAN handling. Inspect your Certificate definitions to identify any that use IP addresses in commonName and verify the field migration is compatible with your use cases.
